programme.title: SkywatchTV - Humans Are Losing Control…To This
programme.desc: The New AI Cold War | Lt Col Robert Maginnis on Skywatch TV The next global conflict wont be fought with missiles — it will be waged through algorithms data centers and the machines quietly shaping how nations think govern and define truth Host Joe Ardis Horn sits down with national security expert and Pentagon veteran Lieutenant Colonel Robert Maginnis to discuss his explosive new book The New AI Cold War Liberty vs Tyranny in the Age of Machine Empires Drawing on decades of experience in foreign affairs and recent studies in generative AI at MIT Maginnis delivers a sobering biblically-grounded analysis of the most transformative technological shift in human history Topics covered include Why AI is not neutral — and who really controls it Chinas race for AI dominance and the threat to Taiwans semiconductor supply chain How Big Tech giants are shaping reality and redefining truth for millions The spiritual stakes of a world governed by machine intelligence Why stewardship — not surrender — is the Christian response to the AI revolution This isnt a distant warning Its already happening And the question isnt whether AI will reshape civilization — its who will be holding the reins when it does Its not about nukes — its about algorithms And its a terrible God — Lt Col Robert Maginnis
